info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Servicing Mandate Management API
info.description: The Servicing Mandate Management API allows organizations to efficiently modify existing servicing mandates for banking services. This API provides essential operations to update mandate details, ensuring compliance with changing customer requirements or regulations. Typical consumers include financial institutions and banking applications that need to manage servicing agreements seamlessly. Users can leverage this API to maintain accurate records and respond to customer needs without delay.
